messages:
Mika: Quick sync before Friday's launch review — we need confirmation on SLA exceptions, final docs scope, and who owns the pricing note for Dedicated customers. Who's taking pricing?
Jordan: I'm on docs ownership. For SLA exceptions legal wants a bulletized list of acceptable degradations + measurable thresholds. Need that by Tue.
Ava: Support needs playbook pages: 'Degraded latency', 'Model fallback', and 'Customer communication template'. I'll draft templates and link them.
Priya: Engineering note: Hosted target = 99.9% uptime and p95 < 120ms for standard sizes. Dedicated currently can't promise p95 <100ms for large-context workloads — that's the SLA delta to call out.
Ben: We can add a runtime fallback flag to route heavy requests to regional pools and change batch sizes. Runtime change is straightforward but needs feature-flag rollout.
Mika: @Ben can you estimate time to wire the flag + tests? Also we need pricing delta between Hosted and Dedicated for the launch announcement. @Liam?
Liam: Finance here — I can do a tiered sheet. Do we want per-token, per-inference, or both shown?
Ava: Both — per-inference for embedding-heavy customers, per-token for chat/LLM usage. Keep an example calc for a 1M token month.
Ben: Runtime work: 48 hours to implement flag + 24 hours for internal tests. I'll open a PR and flag it for review.
Jordan: Docs checklist I'm using: SLA section, Runbook (ops steps + rollback), Support escalation matrix, Pricing note, Canary/rollback plan. I'll add owners in the doc.
Mika: Owner callout: SLA exceptions -> @Priya, Docs -> @Jordan, Support playbooks -> @Ava, Pricing -> @Liam, Rollout flags -> @Ben. Confirm?
Priya: +1
Ava: +1
Liam: +1
Ben: Working on it, will post the PR link once ready.
deploy-bot: Heads up — code freeze in 36h for the release branch.
Jordan: Quick question: If we ship GA with documented SLA exceptions that legal hasn't signed off on yet, is that a hard block?
Legal-Bot: Legal reminder: Any SLA deviation requires legal approval and a recorded exception. Please attach proposed exceptions doc for review.
Mika: I'll attach the exceptions draft to the legal review today. Also: for customer pilots with contract redlines, who owns negotiations — @Liam or @Customer-Success?
Liam: Finance handles pricing redlines, Customer Success owns relationship and final commercial acceptance. We'll coordinate.
Ava: I'll add Customer Success contact info into the playbook and link the escalation flow.
Ben: FYI — quantization and perf tuning for Dedicated could change accuracy by ~1-2% for some models; we need evals for top 5 pilot customers' prompts. ETA 4 days for evaluation results.
Mika: Ok — plan: Ben runs evals, Liam prepares pricing sheet, Jordan updates docs, Ava drafts support playbooks, Priya finalizes SLA exceptions draft. Reconvene after PRs and sheets are linked. Thanks everyone.
